programmes.d: The station 42 and Three Rock crews are called to a backfire started by a private firefighting company to protect a high-end winery but instead threatens to grow out of control.

As Jesse enjoys a day sailing with his daughter, Gracie (Chloe Csengery), pirates suddenly seize their yacht, take all the passengers hostage and attack Jesse, leaving it up to his team to quickly locate and rescue his daughter.
Kai goes undercover as a chef in a local restaurant to gather intel on a notorious criminal kingpin with a connection to the eatery.

When a ransomware attempt causes a dam to malfunction, Ernie and a team of hackers are tasked to find the culprit before all power and water is cut off on the island. Also, Lucy and Whistler work together, giving Whistler a chance to apologize to Lucy.

NCIS Agents Nick Torres (Wilmer Valderrama) and Jessica Knight (Katrina Law) travel to Hawai'i when they learn a witness in one of their cases has turned up with crucial evidence, on a special crossover episode of the CBS Original series NCIS: HAWAI'I.
The team investigates a shipwreck carrying exotic animals that now threaten the native wildlife on Oahu; Alex sustains a career-ending injury; Kai asks a fish and wildlife agent out on a date.
When a Navy seaman is involved in a murder, the team is called upon to work the case on its day off; Lucy finds out Whistler turned down a promotion in Washington to stay in Hawai'i.
The station 42 and Three Rock crews face a daring rescue when a massive mudslide tears through Edgewater. Meanwhile, Bode's (Max Theriot) freedom is on the line at his parole hearing.

Five years ago, Bode burned down everything in his life, leaving town with a big secret. Now he's back, with the rap sheet of a criminal and the audacity to believe in a chance for redemption with Cal Fire.
After Bode requests to be transferred to a different city, his future in Edgewater hangs in the balance. Meanwhile, the crew joins forces to protect the town from a treacherous storm.
When the crew responds to a call in a remote forest, they come under fire by an outlaw protecting illegal marijuana crops.
Capt. Milius returns to Hawaii for a secret prisoner exchange operation, and brings in Jane to be his personal security escort in the Philippines, where the exchange will take place.

Capt. Milius continues to work with Tennant and her team in the aftermath of the prisoner exchange between the US and Eastern Europe; Whistler takes Ernie's advice and makes a grand gesture in hopes of winning back Lucy.
Picking up from the NCIS episode, the team gets the warning that Maxwell is headed to the island. They greet a plane with several dead passengers, no sign of Maxwell.

When Marine Staff Sergeant Travis Cobb's body is found crushed in a junkyard car, NCIS is called to investigate. We learn our Sergeant also participated in illegal street races, in true Fast and Furious style.

Tennant and the NCIS team are called to investigate a fatal car crash involving a Navy Officer. But this accident is more complicated than meets the eye. The real Navy Officer is still alive and the dead woman is an imposter.
When a Navy sailor washes up dead, the NCIS team brings CGIS Special Agent Pike to unmask the mystery and catch a possible serial killer on the island.
